description: Send one Instagram DM to a person who messaged this account, from the account owner. It cannot be taken back, so show the user the words first. Instagram only allows it within 24 hours of their last message. Replying pauses automations for this person for 5 minutes, like replying in the app. If the answer says Instagram did not confirm, do not send it again: tell the user to check the chat. Needs inbox access.

person_id.description: The person to answer, from sprkly_list_inbox_threads.

profile_id.description: The connected Instagram account, from sprkly_list_inbox_threads.
